Package com.stevenlagoy.jsonic

Interface Jsonic<T extends Jsonic<T>>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the object implementing this interface (should be the same as the Class Name).
public interface Jsonic<T extends Jsonic<T>>
Interface allowing Json methods to be used to create and store JSONObjects representing instances of classes which implement this interface.

Example Usage:

class MyClass implements Jsonic<MyClass> { ... }

    • fromJson

      T fromJson(JSONObject json)
      Interpret a JSONObject into an object of this type.
      Parameters:
      json - A JSONObject containing any number of the fields for this object as key-value pairs.
      Returns:
      The Object interpreted from the Json. Note that this object's fields will also be set.

    • collectionToJson

      static List<JSONObject> collectionToJson(Collection<?> collection)
      Turns a collection into a JSONObject list. Any elements which extend Jsonic<> will use their .toJson() methods, and any other not-null elements will be passed to the Jsonic.toJson(Object) function.
      Parameters:
      collection - Collection containing any type.
      Returns:
      List of JSONObjects with the contents of the passed collection.
